At Level 2, reveals hidden enemies in spotlight radius. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|A cliff tower with great range that deals damage over time with burn, applies confusion, and helps to combat hidden enemies.|Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Spotlight Tech''' is a cliff tower which uses a spotlight beam to burn and confuse enemies, while also revealing [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies. It attacks enemies using a spotlight, which damages enemies with its bright light ray. This light ray takes some time to move from one target to another. This light ray has a specific radius in which it damage enemies. It will damage an infinite number of enemies, though enemies will receive less damage the further they are from the center. Depending on the distance, they will either receive 100% of the stated, 60% or 35%. This spotlight can also apply one of the following effects based on the level: *Starting from Level 1, it will apply burn to enemies. This will deal additional damage over time, even if they are not currently in the spotlight's light ray. *Starting from Level 2, it will start to reveal [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies by applying [[Exposed]] to them. This lets towers without hidden detection to target them. If the enemy gets out of the spotlight, it will lose [[Exposed]], meaning towers need hidden detection for it again. *At Level 4, it can confuse enemies. This happens once it deals 1,800 damage to enemies, after which it will confuse all enemies currently in its spotlight. The '''Spotlight Tech''' has a placement limit of one. It can detect [[Flying]] enemies from Level 0, [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies from Level 1 and [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies from Level 2. ==Upgrades== {{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade }} ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:PirateSpotlightTech0.png|175px]] |- !Skin ||{{Colour|Pirate|Pirate}} |- !Rarity |{{Colour|Rare}} |- !Daily Store Cost |{{Coins|5,000}} |- !Obtained From |[[Pirate Crate|Pirate Skincrate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Spotlight Tech''' can be an effective AOE tower, due to it dealing damage to an infinite number of enemies and applying burn. **Setting the '''Spotlight Tech''' to ''Random'' allows it to apply burn to nearly every enemy on the map, potentially increasing the maximum damage output to a far larger extent. **Stalling towers like the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Freezer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be used to clump up enemies in one spot, allowing the '''Spotlight Tech''' to hit more enemies with its spotlight. *Starting from Level 2, the '''Spotlight Tech''' has the ability to reveal [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy in its spotlight diameter. **This makes it useful alongside towers that do not have hidden detection, like the [[Ranger]], top path [[Pursuit]] or [[Swarmer]]. *At Level 4, the '''Spotlight Tech''' will begin to confuse enemies once it reaches 1,800 total damage. **Only damage from the spotlight boosts it. Any damage from burn will not contribute to the threshold, meaning the best method of activating it is having as many enemies in its spotlight as possible. ==Trivia== *The '''Spotlight Tech''' is based on the [[Spotlight]]s that appeared during the [[Lunar Overture Event]] and [[The Final Act Event]]. **Additionally '''Spotlight Tech''' is inspired by theatrical technicians called spotlight operators, hence the name. *The '''Spotlight Tech''' is the first exclusive cliff tower. *The '''Spotlight Tech''' is regarded as the ''Spotlight Technician'' in the game's description, and the update log in both the Discord server and in-game. *The '''Spotlight Tech''' is currently the only tower in the game to have two upgrades with the same name (Levels 1 and 3 both share the name ''Backstage Crew''). ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]] **'''Spotlight Tech''' added. **{{Bug}} Burn damage does not use the intended damage value.
